title: NusaWrites: Constructing High-Quality Corpora for Underrepresented and Extremely Low-Resource Languages
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the ability of models to perform topic classification, where 'religion' was one of eight possible topic categories for a given text.
findings: The paper's findings are general across all tasks and topics, including religion. It found that existing large language models (both fine-tuned and zero-shot) consistently underperform compared to classical baselines on these low-resource Indonesian languages. The results were not broken down by specific topics, so there are no findings exclusively about model performance on religious texts.
